proposals.name: A Lamp Left Burning
proposals.why: A lamp left burning in the window is the whole of my charter in one line: the night is here, and the light falls exactly where someone is still at work.

proposals.name: Nocturnes by Lamplight
proposals.why: A nocturne is quiet music played at night by one warm light, and that is how this panel should hear every design it judges.

proposals.name: The Small Hours
proposals.why: The small hours after midnight are when the elves finish the shoemaker's work, so a panel named for them keeps watch while the rest of the city sleeps.
